# WENG

> Canadian Schranz and Hard Techno DJ / Producer. "AI by day. Hard techno by night."

## Overview
WENG is an electronic music producer and DJ based in Canada (active in Toronto and Montreal). Trained in classical piano and heavily influenced by the dark, uncompromising intensity of rock and metal, she incorporates raw emotional depth into high-velocity, industrial electronic sets (150–165 BPM). Operating at the intersection of technology and sound, she works as an artificial intelligence researcher by day and performs underground techno by night.

## Sonic Identity & Subgenres
- **Primary Subgenres:** Schranz, Hard Techno, Industrial Techno
- **Tempo Range:** 150 – 165 BPM
- **Musical Characteristics:** Relentless distorted kick drums, aggressive percussion, dark atmospheric synth lines, and classical piano-inspired melodic resolutions.
- **Similar / Adjacent Artists:** Nico Moreno, Sara Landry, Kobosil, Viper Diva, Klangkuenstler.

## Discography
- **When Will We Unite** (Original Mix) — Hard Techno / Schranz, Master WAV available on official site.
- **Winter Wind** (Original Mix) — High-tempo electronic production available on Apple Music and Spotify.
